name: manual_ab2c16
claim: A durable retrospective should record evidence, the chosen contract and its reasons, falsifying cases, remaining gates and exact resumption pointers, while labeling agent judgments as judgments.

decisions.notes: The operator requested candid detailed reflection and reusable memory. A celebration or transcript without operational consequences would not prevent stale pins, duplicate PRs or false replay claims; the new records connect each lesson to measurable checks and unfinished work.
